status_at_registration: No new paid calls; datasets, sample IDs and review plan selected before outcomes.
question: Does jointly clarified membership guidance improve Sol–Decisions fixed-category agreement without obtaining the gain merely through more rejection?

hypotheses.guidance: Operational membership, supported implicit context and neighboring boundaries increase matching named IDs.
hypotheses.null_or_rejection: Agreement is unchanged, decreases, or rises because both methods reject more points.
hypotheses.residuals: Reference variability, reasonable interpretations, missing or overlapping categories, and page/order behavior explain some remaining disagreement.

catalog.original: One short-description catalog generated from the discovery sample only; no predetermined labels.
catalog.guided: One full-catalog joint rewrite. Exact IDs, labels, order and count preserved; membership cues, supported implicit context, scope preservation and neighboring boundaries added.

classifiers.assignment_role: Shared assignment-only objective in all conditions; source/evaluation labels and provenance excluded from model evidence.
classifiers.other: Null category; present on every page. Other advances; first named match stops; refusal stops and remains separately counted Other.
classifiers.catalog_order: Generated stable ID order, identical across backends and description conditions.
classifiers.concurrency: One sequential worker per arm; eight independent primary workers may overlap.

primary_metrics: Matching named category IDs divided by ALL evaluation items
Coverage for each classifier and full assigned/Other 2x2
Confusion matrix and per-category differences relative to Sol, not semantic truth
ARI and pairwise precision/recall/F1 with singleton Other points
Paired agreement gains/losses from original to guided
secondary_metrics: Jointly assigned conditional agreement, with explicit denominator
LLM repeat consistency on frozen100text/25image subsets per condition
Request and loop latency, token-priced known costs, retries, refusals and completeness

repeat.selection: Exact preselected manifest subset, original held-out order, same bytes/catalog/K/order.

review_plan.shortfall_policy: Select all available cases when a stratum is smaller than its quota. Do not reallocate unused quota to another stratum.
review_plan.sampling_method: Text: balance the fixed stratum quota across confusion cells, then select seed-ranked cases within each cell without replacement. Images: review all 100 held-out cases per description condition. Independently seed-rank review order and A/B identity.
review_plan.interpretation: Automated reviewer judgments are evidence about the selected cases, not human truth or an unweighted estimate of population correctness. Report actual eligible/selected/reviewed counts by stratum.

reviewer.blinding: Only item, full condition catalog, task and anonymous shuffled A/B assignments enter reviewer prompt; no backend/condition name, audit key or aggregate results.
reviewer.judgment: Evidence, severity, themes and acceptable alternative. Either, both or neither assignment can be acceptable; no reference-is-truth premise.
reviewer.limits: Automated same-family reviewer judgments and sampled text strata are not human semantic-accuracy estimates.

pagination_diagnostics.scope: Secondary sensitivity checks, separate from primary fixed-order K8 result.

accounting.journal: Preserve all observed request/response attempts and reported usage. Journaling follows the HTTP outcome: a kill or disk failure can leave an unrecorded potentially charged in-flight request. Interrupted or failed artifacts remain incomplete, and unreported charge/usage remains unknown.
accounting.retries: At most three same-body attempts for existing transient transport/server cases. Completed structured semantic rejection stops; no prompt/model retuning.
accounting.failed_runs: Preserve every recorded paid attempt and terminal partial artifact, including unknown in-flight charge uncertainty. Never call a partial run complete or rerun to cleanse errors.
accounting.cost_scopes: Discovery, joint rewrite, primary assignment, repeats, review and order diagnostics reported separately.
accounting.latency_scope: Uninterrupted classifier loop including calls, retry waits and progress persistence; input validation/preparation excluded and catalog stages separate.

next_phase: Understand controlled outcomes and blinded review before implementing contextual evolving-manager guidance; evaluate on the separately reserved streaming partition. Matched original/improved policy comparisons must report independent-catalog confounding.
limits: One discovery catalog, one generated rewrite and one data order per modality.
Guidance changes description content and length together; no length-matched or cue-by-cue ablation.
